personal.name: Gaurab Samadder
personal.headline: M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering @ IIT Kharagpur
personal.bio: M.Tech student in Computer Science & Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur, specializing in High-Performance Computing, Distributed Systems, and Machine Learning.
personal.about:
Hi, I am Gaurab Samadder. I am currently pursuing my M.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur (IIT KGP). My technical and research interests lie in Distributed Systems, Systems Programming, Deep Learning, and Advanced Algorithms.

At IIT Kharagpur, I have been working on building scalable systems, optimizing computational workflows, and exploring neural architectures. Prior to joining IIT KGP, I completed my Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science & Engineering with distinction.

projects.title: Distributed Fault-Tolerant Key-Value Store
projects.description: High-throughput distributed storage engine engineered in C++20 implementing the Raft consensus algorithm with leader election, log compaction, snapshotting, and write-ahead logging.

projects.title: CUDA GPU Tensor Acceleration Engine
projects.description: Custom GPU kernels in CUDA utilizing shared memory tiling and warp-level primitives to accelerate large-scale matrix operations, achieving 3.8x speedup over standard baseline CPU executions.

projects.title: Custom Linux Kernel CPU Scheduler
projects.description: Engineered a multi-level priority CPU scheduler inside the Linux Kernel (v5.15) with automated starvation prevention, dynamic task weighting, and eBPF tracing.

projects.title: Parallel Graph Analytics Engine with OpenMP
projects.description: High-performance multi-threaded graph analytics pipeline computing PageRank and Betweenness Centrality on graphs with 10M+ edges in under 4 seconds.
